fr.title: La génération exclue de la propriété : pourquoi les premiers acheteurs sont de plus en plus âgés

segments.src: For decades, buying a first home was a milestone people expected to reach in their twenties or early thirties.
segments.tr: Pendant des décennies, l'achat d'une première maison était une étape importante que les gens espéraient atteindre dans la vingtaine ou au début de la trentaine.

segments.src: That expectation has shifted.
segments.tr: Cette attente a évolué.

segments.src: According to recent annual surveys from the National Association of Realtors, the median age of first-time buyers has climbed to roughly 38, up from about 29 in the early 1980s.
segments.tr: Selon les récentes enquêtes annuelles de la National Association of Realtors, l'âge médian des premiers acheteurs est passé à environ 38 ans, contre environ 29 ans au début des années 1980.

segments.src: The share of first-time buyers among all purchasers has also hovered near record lows.
segments.tr: La part des premiers acheteurs parmi l'ensemble des acquéreurs a également frôlé des plus-bas historiques.

segments.src: Exact figures vary by year and survey, but the direction is clear: the entry point to homeownership keeps moving later in life.
segments.tr: Les chiffres exacts varient selon les années et les enquêtes, mais la tendance est claire : l'accès à la propriété se fait de plus en plus tard dans la vie.

segments.src: ## Why the Door Is Harder to Open
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi la porte est plus difficile à ouvrir

segments.src: Three forces work together to delay purchases.
segments.tr: Trois facteurs se conjuguent pour retarder les achats.

segments.src: ### 1. High prices
segments.tr: ### 1. Des prix élevés

segments.src: Home prices rose sharply during the pandemic years and have mostly held their gains since.
segments.tr: Les prix des logements ont fortement augmenté pendant la pandémie et se sont pour l'essentiel maintenus depuis.

segments.src: Incomes have grown too, but not as fast as prices in many metro areas.
segments.tr: Les revenus ont progressé eux aussi, mais pas aussi vite que les prix dans de nombreuses zones métropolitaines.

segments.src: The result is a wider gap between what a typical household earns and what a typical home costs.
segments.tr: Il en résulte un écart plus important entre ce qu'un ménage moyen gagne et ce qu'un logement moyen coûte.

segments.src: A larger down payment, even a modest one of 5% to 10%, now takes years of saving, especially for renters who also face rising living costs.
segments.tr: Un apport personnel plus conséquent, même modeste de 5 % à 10 %, nécessite désormais des années d'épargne, en particulier pour les locataires qui font également face à la hausse du coût de la vie.

segments.src: ### 2. Elevated mortgage rates
segments.tr: ### 2. Des taux d'intérêt hypothécaires élevés

segments.src: Mortgage rates were below 3% for a stretch in 2020 and 2021.
segments.tr: Les taux hypothécaires étaient inférieurs à 3 % pendant une période en 2020 et 2021.

segments.src: Since then they have been far higher.
segments.tr: Depuis, ils sont nettement plus élevés.

segments.src: A higher rate raises the monthly payment on the same loan, which cuts the price a buyer can afford.
segments.tr: Un taux plus élevé augmente la mensualité pour un même emprunt, ce qui réduit le prix qu'un acheteur peut se permettre d'payer.

segments.src: Even a gap of one or two percentage points can add hundreds of dollars to a monthly payment and shrink a buyer's budget by tens of thousands of dollars.
segments.tr: Même un écart d'un ou deux points de pourcentage peut ajouter des centaines de dollars à un paiement mensuel et réduire le budget d'un acheteur de dizaines de milliers de dollars.

segments.src: ### 3. Thin inventory
segments.tr: ### 3. Un inventaire restreint

segments.src: Many current homeowners hold low-rate mortgages from earlier years.
segments.tr: De nombreux propriétaires actuels détiennent des prêts hypothécaires à taux bas souscrits les années précédentes.

segments.src: Selling would mean trading that loan for a much more expensive one, so many choose to stay put.
segments.tr: Vendre signifierait troquer ce prêt contre un autre beaucoup plus cher, si bien que beaucoup choisissent de ne pas bouger.

segments.src: This "lock-in effect" keeps fewer existing homes on the market.
segments.tr: Cet « effet de blocage » (lock-in effect) maintient un nombre restreint de logements existants sur le marché.

segments.src: At the same time, years of underbuilding, along with zoning limits and higher construction costs, have left a shortfall in entry-level housing.
segments.tr: Dans le même temps, des années de sous-construction, conjuguées aux restrictions de zonage et à des coûts de construction plus élevés, ont créé une pénurie de logements abordables pour les débutants.

segments.src: With fewer choices, buyers compete for the same modest homes, which supports prices.
segments.tr: Avec moins de choix, les acheteurs se disputent les mêmes logements modestes, ce qui soutient les prix.

segments.src: ## What Delay Means for Families
segments.tr: ## Ce que ce retard signifie pour les familles

segments.src: The timing of homeownership is tied closely to other life decisions.
segments.tr: Le moment de l'accès à la propriété est étroitement lié à d'autres décisions de vie.

segments.src: - **Family plans.** Surveys regularly find that housing costs are one reason some adults postpone having children or have fewer than they wanted. A stable home, space for a growing family and a good school district often figure into these choices.
segments.tr: - **Projets familiaux.** Des enquêtes montrent régulièrement que le coût du logement est l'une des raisons pour lesquelles certains adultes reportent le moment d'avoir des enfants ou en ont moins que souhaité. Un logement stable, de l'espace pour une famille qui s'agrandit et un bon secteur scolaire entrent souvent en ligne de compte dans ces choix.

segments.src: - **Where people live.** Some buyers move to lower-cost regions or accept longer commutes. Others stay with parents or share housing longer than they would like.
segments.tr: - **Lieu de résidence.** Certains acheteurs s'installent dans des régions moins chères ou acceptent des trajets plus longs. D'autres restent chez leurs parents ou partagent un logement plus longtemps qu'ils ne le souhaiteraient.

segments.src: - **Career flexibility.** Renters can move easily, but they also face rent increases and less control over where they live. Buyers who stretch to purchase may feel less able to change jobs or cities.
segments.tr: - **Flexibilité professionnelle.** Les locataires peuvent déménager facilement, mais ils subissent aussi des hausses de loyer et un moindre contrôle sur leur lieu de vie. Les acheteurs qui s'endettent au maximum pour acheter peuvent se sentir moins en mesure de changer d'emploi ou de ville.

segments.src: None of this is a rule for every household, and many people are happy renting.
segments.tr: Rien de tout cela ne constitue une règle absolue pour chaque ménage, et de nombreuses personnes sont très satisfaites d'être locataires.

segments.src: But for those who want to buy, the delay carries real costs.
segments.tr: Mais pour ceux qui veulent acheter, ce retard entraîne de véritables coûts.

segments.src: ## The Wealth-Building Gap
segments.tr: ## L'écart de constitution de patrimoine

segments.src: Housing is the largest asset for many American families.
segments.tr: Le logement représente le principal actif pour de nombreuses familles américaines.

segments.src: Homeowners build equity as they pay down a mortgage and, in most periods, as home values rise.
segments.tr: Les propriétaires se constituent un capital au fur et à mesure qu'ils remboursent leur prêt hypothécaire et, durant la plupart des périodes, à mesure que la valeur du bien augmente.

segments.src: Buying at 38 instead of 28 means ten fewer years of that process.
segments.tr: Acheter à 38 ans au lieu de 28 signifie dix ans de moins consacrés à ce processus.

segments.src: Federal Reserve data consistently show that homeowners have a much higher median net worth than renters.
segments.tr: Les données de la Réserve fédérale montrent régulièrement que les propriétaires ont une valeur nette médiane nettement plus élevée que les locataires.

segments.src: Part of that gap reflects age and income, since homeowners tend to be older and earn more.
segments.tr: Une partie de cet écart reflète l'âge et le revenu, les propriétaires ayant tendance à être plus âgés et à gagner davantage.

segments.src: Still, a later start leaves less time to build equity before retirement, and it can mean carrying a mortgage into later years.
segments.tr: Malgré tout, commencer plus tard laisse moins de temps pour se constituer un capital avant la retraite, et cela peut signifier avoir encore un prêt hypothécaire à rembourser plus tard dans la vie.

segments.src: There is also a generational question.
segments.tr: Il y a aussi une question générationnelle.

segments.src: Older cohorts often bought when homes were cheaper compared with incomes.
segments.tr: Les générations plus anciennes ont souvent acheté à une époque où les logements étaient moins chers par rapport aux revenus.

segments.src: Younger adults who start later may find it harder to match their parents' wealth, and may have less to pass on or less ability to help their own children.
segments.tr: Les jeunes adultes qui débutent plus tard pourraient avoir plus de mal à égaler le patrimoine de leurs parents, et pourraient avoir moins à transmettre ou moins de capacité à aider leurs propres enfants.

segments.src: ## The Wider Housing Market
segments.tr: ## Le marché immobilier au sens large

segments.src: An older first-time buyer affects more than one household.
segments.tr: Le vieillissement du premier acheteur concerne bien plus d'un seul ménage.

segments.src: - **Slower move-up chain.** Starter homes are the first link. When fewer first-time buyers enter, owners of those homes have fewer buyers, which can slow the sequence of sales that frees up larger homes.
segments.tr: - **Ralentissement de la chaîne de mobilité.** Les premiers logements sont le premier maillon. Lorsque moins de premiers acheteurs arrivent sur le marché, les propriétaires de ces biens ont moins d'acquéreurs, ce qui peut ralentir la chaîne de ventes qui libère des logements plus grands.

segments.src: - **Rental demand.** Households that stay renters longer compete for apartments and single-family rentals, which can keep rents elevated.
segments.tr: - **Demande locative.** Les ménages qui restent locataires plus longtemps sont en concurrence pour les appartements et les maisons individuelles en location, ce qui peut maintenir les loyers à un niveau élevé.

segments.src: - **Local economies.** Home purchases support spending on furniture, repairs and services. Fewer and later purchases can soften those effects.
segments.tr: - **Économies locales.** Les achats immobiliers soutiennent les dépenses d'ameublement, de rénovation et de services. Des achats moins nombreux et plus tardifs peuvent atténuer ces effets.

segments.src: ## What Could Help
segments.tr: ## Ce qui pourrait aider

segments.src: No single fix exists, and economists disagree about the best mix.
segments.tr: Il n'existe pas de solution unique, et les économistes s'opposent sur le meilleur dosage.

segments.src: Commonly discussed approaches include:
segments.tr: Parmi les approches fréquemment évoquées :

segments.src: - **Building more homes**, particularly smaller and lower-priced ones, by easing zoning and permitting limits.
segments.tr: - **Construire plus de logements**, en particulier des logements plus petits et plus abordables, en assouplissant les règles de zonage et de permis de construire.

segments.src: - **Down payment assistance** programs offered by states and localities, which can help qualified buyers close the savings gap. These can also add demand, so their effect on prices is debated.
segments.tr: - **L'aide à l'apport personnel** proposée par les États et les collectivités locales, qui peut aider les acheteurs admissibles à combler l'écart d'épargne. Ces programmes peuvent aussi accroître la demande, de sorte que leur effet sur les prix fait débat.

segments.src: - **Falling mortgage rates**, which would improve affordability but could also bring more buyers and more competition.
segments.tr: - **La baisse des taux d'intérêt hypothécaires**, qui améliorerait l'accessibilité financière mais pourrait aussi attirer davantage d'acheteurs et accroître la concurrence.

segments.src: - **Easing the lock-in effect**, through ideas such as portable or assumable mortgages, though each has trade-offs.
segments.tr: - **L'atténuation de l'effet de blocage**, à travers des idées comme les prêts transferables ou assumables, bien que chacune présente des compromis.

segments.src: ## What Prospective Buyers Can Do
segments.tr: ## Ce que les acheteurs potentiels peuvent faire

segments.src: Individual choices cannot solve a market-wide problem, but some steps may help:
segments.tr: Les choix individuels ne peuvent pas résoudre un problème qui touche l'ensemble du marché, mais certaines démarches peuvent aider :

segments.src: 1. Check your credit report and work on your score before applying.
segments.tr: 1. Vérifiez votre dossier de crédit et travaillez sur votre score avant de faire une demande.

segments.src: 2. Set a realistic monthly budget that includes taxes, insurance and maintenance, not only the mortgage payment.
segments.tr: 2. Établissez un budget mensuel réaliste qui inclut les taxes, l'assurance et l'entretien, et pas seulement la mensualité du prêt.

segments.src: 3. Look into state and local assistance programs and first-time buyer loan options.
segments.tr: 3. Renseignez-vous sur les programmes d'aide régionaux et locaux ainsi que sur les options de prêt pour premiers acheteurs.

segments.src: 4. Compare lenders, since offers can differ meaningfully.
segments.tr: 4. Comparez les prêteurs, car les offres peuvent différer de manière significative.

segments.src: 5. Consider a wider search area or a smaller property as a first step.
segments.tr: 5. Envisagez une zone de recherche plus large ou un bien plus petit comme première étape.

segments.src: 6. Keep an emergency fund so that buying does not leave you without a cushion.
segments.tr: 6. Conservez un fonds d'urgence afin que l'achat ne vous laisse pas sans réserve financière.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## En conclusion

segments.src: The rising age of the typical first-time buyer reflects a housing market where prices, borrowing costs and limited supply all push in the same direction.
segments.tr: L'augmentation de l'âge du premier acheteur moyen témoigne d'un marché immobilier où les prix, les coûts d'emprunt et l'offre limitée poussent tous dans la même direction.

segments.src: The delay shapes when families form, how quickly households build wealth and how the market functions.
segments.tr: Ce retard influence le moment où les familles se forment, la rapidité avec laquelle les ménages accumulent du patrimoine et la manière dont le marché fonctionne.

segments.src: Easing it will likely take a mix of more construction, better access to credit and time.
segments.tr: Y remédier nécessitera vraisemblablement un mélange d'accroissement de la construction, d'un meilleur accès au crédit et du temps.

segments.src: - **Down payment assistance** programs offered by states and localities, which can help qualified buyers close the savings gap. These can also add demand, so their effect on prices is debated.
segments.tr: - **Programas de auxílio para entrada** oferecidos por estados e municípios, que podem ajudar compradores qualificados a fechar a lacuna de poupança. Eles também podem aumentar a demanda, de modo que seu efeito nos preços é debatido.

segments.src: - **Falling mortgage rates**, which would improve affordability but could also bring more buyers and more competition.
segments.tr: - **Queda nas taxas de juros imobiliários**, o que melhoraria a acessibilidade financeira, mas também poderia trazer mais compradores e mais concorrência.

segments.src: - **Easing the lock-in effect**, through ideas such as portable or assumable mortgages, though each has trade-offs.
segments.tr: - **Atenuar o efeito de aprisionamento**, por meio de ideias como hipotecas transferíveis ou assumíveis, embora cada uma tenha seus prós e contras.

segments.src: ## What Prospective Buyers Can Do
segments.tr: ## O Que os Futuros Compradores Podem Fazer

segments.src: Individual choices cannot solve a market-wide problem, but some steps may help:
segments.tr: Escolhas individuais não podem resolver um problema de todo o mercado, mas algumas etapas podem ajudar:

segments.src: 1. Check your credit report and work on your score before applying.
segments.tr: 1. Verifique seu histórico de crédito e trabalhe na sua pontuação antes de se candidatar.

segments.src: 2. Set a realistic monthly budget that includes taxes, insurance and maintenance, not only the mortgage payment.
segments.tr: 2. Defina um orçamento mensal realista que inclua impostos, seguro e manutenção, e não apenas a prestação da hipoteca.

segments.src: 3. Look into state and local assistance programs and first-time buyer loan options.
segments.tr: 3. Pesquise programas de auxílio estaduais e locais e opções de empréstimo para compradores do primeiro imóvel.

segments.src: 4. Compare lenders, since offers can differ meaningfully.
segments.tr: 4. Compare credores, pois as ofertas podem diferir significativamente.

segments.src: 5. Consider a wider search area or a smaller property as a first step.
segments.tr: 5. Considere uma área de busca mais ampla ou um imóvel menor como primeiro passo.

segments.src: 6. Keep an emergency fund so that buying does not leave you without a cushion.
segments.tr: 6. Mantenha uma reserva de emergência para que a compra não o deixe sem uma proteção financeira.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Conclusão

segments.src: The rising age of the typical first-time buyer reflects a housing market where prices, borrowing costs and limited supply all push in the same direction.
segments.tr: O aumento da idade do comprador típico do primeiro imóvel reflete um mercado imobiliário onde preços, custos de empréstimo e oferta limitada pressionam na mesma direção.

segments.src: The delay shapes when families form, how quickly households build wealth and how the market functions.
segments.tr: O adiamento molda quando as famílias se formam, quão rapidamente as famílias acumulam patrimônio e como o mercado funciona.

segments.src: Easing it will likely take a mix of more construction, better access to credit and time.
segments.tr: Atenuar essa situação provavelmente exigirá uma combinação de mais construção, melhor acesso ao crédito e tempo.

in.title: Generasi yang Terkunci: Mengapa Pembeli Rumah Pertama Semakin Berumur

segments.src: For decades, buying a first home was a milestone people expected to reach in their twenties or early thirties.
segments.tr: Selama beberapa dekade, membeli rumah pertama adalah tonggak sejarah yang diharapkan dicapai orang di usia dua puluhan atau awal tiga puluhan.

segments.src: That expectation has shifted.
segments.tr: Harapan itu telah bergeser.

segments.src: According to recent annual surveys from the National Association of Realtors, the median age of first-time buyers has climbed to roughly 38, up from about 29 in the early 1980s.
segments.tr: Menurut survei tahunan terbaru dari National Association of Realtors, usia rata-rata pembeli rumah pertama telah naik menjadi sekitar 38 tahun, naik dari sekitar 29 tahun pada awal 1980-an.

segments.src: The share of first-time buyers among all purchasers has also hovered near record lows.
segments.tr: Pangsa pembeli rumah pertama di antara semua pembeli juga berada di dekat rekor terendah.

segments.src: Exact figures vary by year and survey, but the direction is clear: the entry point to homeownership keeps moving later in life.
segments.tr: Angka pastinya bervariasi menurut tahun dan survei, tetapi arahnya jelas: titik masuk untuk kepemilikan rumah terus bergerak ke usia yang lebih tua.

segments.src: ## Why the Door Is Harder to Open
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Pintu Semakin Sulit Dibuka

segments.src: Three forces work together to delay purchases.
segments.tr: Tiga kekuatan bekerja bersama untuk menunda pembelian.

segments.src: ### 1. High prices
segments.tr: ### 1. Harga tinggi

segments.src: Home prices rose sharply during the pandemic years and have mostly held their gains since.
segments.tr: Harga rumah naik tajam selama tahun-tahun pandemi dan sebagian besar mempertahankan kenaikannya sejak saat itu.

segments.src: Incomes have grown too, but not as fast as prices in many metro areas.
segments.tr: Pendapatan juga tumbuh, tetapi tidak secepat harga di banyak wilayah metropolitan.

segments.src: The result is a wider gap between what a typical household earns and what a typical home costs.
segments.tr: Hasilnya adalah kesenjangan yang lebih lebar antara penghasilan rumah tangga pada umumnya dan biaya rumah pada umumnya.

segments.src: A larger down payment, even a modest one of 5% to 10%, now takes years of saving, especially for renters who also face rising living costs.
segments.tr: Uang muka yang lebih besar, bahkan yang sederhana sebesar 5% hingga 10%, sekarang membutuhkan waktu bertahun-tahun untuk menabung, terutama bagi penyewa yang juga menghadapi kenaikan biaya hidup.

segments.src: ### 2. Elevated mortgage rates
segments.tr: ### 2. Suku bunga hipotek yang tinggi

segments.src: Mortgage rates were below 3% for a stretch in 2020 and 2021.
segments.tr: Suku bunga hipotek berada di bawah 3% untuk beberapa waktu pada tahun 2020 dan 2021.

segments.src: Since then they have been far higher.
segments.tr: Sejak saat itu, suku bunga jauh lebih tinggi.

segments.src: A higher rate raises the monthly payment on the same loan, which cuts the price a buyer can afford.
segments.tr: Suku bunga yang lebih tinggi meningkatkan pembayaran bulanan untuk pinjaman yang sama, yang memotong harga yang mampu dibayar oleh pembeli.

segments.src: Even a gap of one or two percentage points can add hundreds of dollars to a monthly payment and shrink a buyer's budget by tens of thousands of dollars.
segments.tr: Bahkan selisih satu atau dua poin persentase dapat menambah ratusan dolar pada pembayaran bulanan dan menyusutkan anggaran pembeli hingga puluhan ribu dolar.

segments.src: ### 3. Thin inventory
segments.tr: ### 3. Persediaan yang tipis

segments.src: Many current homeowners hold low-rate mortgages from earlier years.
segments.tr: Banyak pemilik rumah saat ini memegang hipotek berbunga rendah dari tahun-tahun sebelumnya.

segments.src: Selling would mean trading that loan for a much more expensive one, so many choose to stay put.
segments.tr: Menjual berarti menukar pinjaman itu dengan pinjaman yang jauh lebih mahal, jadi banyak yang memilih untuk tetap tinggal.

segments.src: This "lock-in effect" keeps fewer existing homes on the market.
segments.tr: Efek "penguncian" ini membuat lebih sedikit rumah yang ada di pasar.

segments.src: At the same time, years of underbuilding, along with zoning limits and higher construction costs, have left a shortfall in entry-level housing.
segments.tr: Pada saat yang sama, bertahun-tahun kurangnya pembangunan, bersama dengan batasan zonasi dan biaya konstruksi yang lebih tinggi, telah menyebabkan kekurangan perumahan tingkat pemula.

segments.src: With fewer choices, buyers compete for the same modest homes, which supports prices.
segments.tr: Dengan pilihan yang lebih sedikit, pembeli bersaing untuk rumah sederhana yang sama, yang mendukung harga.

segments.src: ## What Delay Means for Families
segments.tr: ## Apa Arti Penundaan bagi Keluarga

segments.src: The timing of homeownership is tied closely to other life decisions.
segments.tr: Waktu kepemilikan rumah terkait erat dengan keputusan hidup lainnya.

segments.src: - **Family plans.** Surveys regularly find that housing costs are one reason some adults postpone having children or have fewer than they wanted. A stable home, space for a growing family and a good school district often figure into these choices.
segments.tr: - **Rencana keluarga.** Survei secara rutin menemukan bahwa biaya perumahan adalah salah satu alasan beberapa orang dewasa menunda memiliki anak atau memiliki lebih sedikit anak daripada yang mereka inginkan. Rumah yang stabil, ruang untuk keluarga yang sedang tumbuh, dan distrik sekolah yang baik sering kali menjadi pertimbangan dalam pilihan ini.

segments.src: - **Where people live.** Some buyers move to lower-cost regions or accept longer commutes. Others stay with parents or share housing longer than they would like.
segments.tr: - **Tempat tinggal orang.** Beberapa pembeli pindah ke wilayah dengan biaya lebih rendah atau menerima perjalanan yang lebih lama. Yang lain tinggal bersama orang tua atau berbagi tempat tinggal lebih lama dari yang mereka inginkan.

segments.src: - **Career flexibility.** Renters can move easily, but they also face rent increases and less control over where they live. Buyers who stretch to purchase may feel less able to change jobs or cities.
segments.tr: - **Fleksibilitas karier.** Penyewa dapat pindah dengan mudah, tetapi mereka juga menghadapi kenaikan sewa dan kurang kendali atas tempat tinggal mereka. Pembeli yang memaksakan diri untuk membeli mungkin merasa kurang mampu berganti pekerjaan atau kota.

segments.src: None of this is a rule for every household, and many people are happy renting.
segments.tr: Tidak satu pun dari ini adalah aturan untuk setiap rumah tangga, dan banyak orang senang menyewa.

segments.src: But for those who want to buy, the delay carries real costs.
segments.tr: Tetapi bagi mereka yang ingin membeli, penundaan tersebut membawa biaya nyata.

segments.src: ## The Wealth-Building Gap
segments.tr: ## Kesenjangan Membangun Kekayaan

segments.src: Housing is the largest asset for many American families.
segments.tr: Perumahan adalah aset terbesar bagi banyak keluarga Amerika.

segments.src: Homeowners build equity as they pay down a mortgage and, in most periods, as home values rise.
segments.tr: Pemilik rumah membangun ekuitas saat mereka melunasi hipotek dan, dalam sebagian besar periode, saat nilai rumah naik.

segments.src: Buying at 38 instead of 28 means ten fewer years of that process.
segments.tr: Membeli pada usia 38 alih-alih 28 berarti sepuluh tahun lebih sedikit dari proses itu.

segments.src: Federal Reserve data consistently show that homeowners have a much higher median net worth than renters.
segments.tr: Data Federal Reserve secara konsisten menunjukkan bahwa pemilik rumah memiliki kekayaan bersih rata-rata yang jauh lebih tinggi daripada penyewa.

segments.src: Part of that gap reflects age and income, since homeowners tend to be older and earn more.
segments.tr: Sebagian dari kesenjangan itu mencerminkan usia dan pendapatan, karena pemilik rumah cenderung lebih tua dan berpenghasilan lebih tinggi.

segments.src: Still, a later start leaves less time to build equity before retirement, and it can mean carrying a mortgage into later years.
segments.tr: Namun, memulai lebih lambat menyisakan lebih sedikit waktu untuk membangun ekuitas sebelum pensiun, dan itu bisa berarti membawa hipotek hingga usia lanjut.

segments.src: There is also a generational question.
segments.tr: Ada juga pertanyaan antargenerasi.

segments.src: Older cohorts often bought when homes were cheaper compared with incomes.
segments.tr: Kelompok yang lebih tua sering membeli ketika rumah lebih murah dibandingkan dengan pendapatan.

segments.src: Younger adults who start later may find it harder to match their parents' wealth, and may have less to pass on or less ability to help their own children.
segments.tr: Orang dewasa yang lebih muda yang memulai lebih lambat mungkin merasa lebih sulit untuk menyamai kekayaan orang tua mereka, dan mungkin memiliki lebih sedikit untuk diwariskan atau kurang kemampuan untuk membantu anak-anak mereka sendiri.

segments.src: ## The Wider Housing Market
segments.tr: ## Pasar Perumahan yang Lebih Luas

segments.src: An older first-time buyer affects more than one household.
segments.tr: Pembeli rumah pertama yang lebih tua memengaruhi lebih dari satu rumah tangga.

segments.src: - **Slower move-up chain.** Starter homes are the first link. When fewer first-time buyers enter, owners of those homes have fewer buyers, which can slow the sequence of sales that frees up larger homes.
segments.tr: - **Rantai peningkatan yang lebih lambat.** Rumah pemula adalah mata rantai pertama. Ketika lebih sedikit pembeli rumah pertama masuk, pemilik rumah tersebut memiliki lebih sedikit pembeli, yang dapat memperlambat urutan penjualan yang membebaskan rumah yang lebih besar.

segments.src: - **Rental demand.** Households that stay renters longer compete for apartments and single-family rentals, which can keep rents elevated.
segments.tr: - **Permintaan sewa.** Rumah tangga yang tetap menjadi penyewa lebih lama bersaing untuk mendapatkan apartemen dan sewa rumah keluarga tunggal, yang dapat menjaga harga sewa tetap tinggi.

segments.src: - **Local economies.** Home purchases support spending on furniture, repairs and services. Fewer and later purchases can soften those effects.
segments.tr: - **Ekonomi lokal.** Pembelian rumah mendukung pengeluaran untuk furnitur, perbaikan, dan layanan. Pembelian yang lebih sedikit dan lebih lambat dapat memperlunak efek tersebut.

segments.src: ## What Could Help
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Bisa Membantu

segments.src: No single fix exists, and economists disagree about the best mix.
segments.tr: Tidak ada solusi tunggal, dan para ekonom tidak setuju tentang campuran terbaik.

segments.src: Commonly discussed approaches include:
segments.tr: Pendekatan yang sering dibahas meliputi:

segments.src: - **Building more homes**, particularly smaller and lower-priced ones, by easing zoning and permitting limits.
segments.tr: - **Membangun lebih banyak rumah**, terutama yang lebih kecil dan berharga lebih rendah, dengan melonggarkan batasan zonasi dan perizinan.

segments.src: - **Down payment assistance** programs offered by states and localities, which can help qualified buyers close the savings gap. These can also add demand, so their effect on prices is debated.
segments.tr: - **Program bantuan uang muka** yang ditawarkan oleh negara bagian dan daerah, yang dapat membantu pembeli yang memenuhi syarat menutup kesenjangan tabungan. Ini juga dapat menambah permintaan, sehingga efeknya pada harga masih diperdebatkan.

segments.src: - **Falling mortgage rates**, which would improve affordability but could also bring more buyers and more competition.
segments.tr: - **Suku bunga hipotek yang turun**, yang akan meningkatkan keterjangkauan tetapi juga dapat mendatangkan lebih banyak pembeli dan lebih banyak persaingan.

segments.src: - **Easing the lock-in effect**, through ideas such as portable or assumable mortgages, though each has trade-offs.
segments.tr: - **Meringankan efek penguncian**, melalui ide-ide seperti hipotek portabel atau yang dapat diasumsikan, meskipun masing-masing memiliki konsekuensi.

segments.src: ## What Prospective Buyers Can Do
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Bisa Dilakukan Calon Pembeli

segments.src: Individual choices cannot solve a market-wide problem, but some steps may help:
segments.tr: Pilihan individu tidak dapat menyelesaikan masalah di seluruh pasar, tetapi beberapa langkah mungkin membantu:

segments.src: 1. Check your credit report and work on your score before applying.
segments.tr: 1. Periksa laporan kredit Anda dan tingkatkan skor Anda sebelum mendaftar.

segments.src: 2. Set a realistic monthly budget that includes taxes, insurance and maintenance, not only the mortgage payment.
segments.tr: 2. Tetapkan anggaran bulanan yang realistis yang mencakup pajak, asuransi, dan pemeliharaan, bukan hanya pembayaran hipotek.

segments.src: 3. Look into state and local assistance programs and first-time buyer loan options.
segments.tr: 3. Cari tahu tentang program bantuan negara bagian dan lokal serta opsi pinjaman pembeli rumah pertama.

segments.src: 4. Compare lenders, since offers can differ meaningfully.
segments.tr: 4. Bandingkan pemberi pinjaman, karena penawaran bisa berbeda secara signifikan.

segments.src: 5. Consider a wider search area or a smaller property as a first step.
segments.tr: 5. Pertimbangkan area pencarian yang lebih luas atau properti yang lebih kecil sebagai langkah pertama.

segments.src: 6. Keep an emergency fund so that buying does not leave you without a cushion.
segments.tr: 6. Simpan dana darurat agar pembelian tidak membuat Anda tanpa bantalan keuangan.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Kesimpulan

segments.src: The rising age of the typical first-time buyer reflects a housing market where prices, borrowing costs and limited supply all push in the same direction.
segments.tr: Meningkatnya usia pembeli rumah pertama pada umumnya mencerminkan pasar perumahan di mana harga, biaya pinjaman, dan pasokan terbatas semuanya mendorong ke arah yang sama.

segments.src: The delay shapes when families form, how quickly households build wealth and how the market functions.
segments.tr: Penundaan ini membentuk kapan keluarga terbentuk, seberapa cepat rumah tangga membangun kekayaan, dan bagaimana pasar berfungsi.

segments.src: Easing it will likely take a mix of more construction, better access to credit and time.
segments.tr: Meringankannya kemungkinan akan membutuhkan campuran lebih banyak konstruksi, akses yang lebih baik ke kredit, dan waktu.

segments.src: The timing of homeownership is tied closely to other life decisions.
segments.tr: 住宅所有のタイミングは、他の人生の決断と密接に関係しています。

segments.src: - **Family plans.** Surveys regularly find that housing costs are one reason some adults postpone having children or have fewer than they wanted. A stable home, space for a growing family and a good school district often figure into these choices.
segments.tr: - **家族計画。** 調査では、住宅コストが、一部の成人が子供を持つことを先延ばしにしたり、希望よりも少ない人数にしたりする理由の一つであることが定期的に示されています。安定した住まい、成長する家族のためのスペース、そして良い学区は、多くの場合、こうした選択に影響を与えます。

segments.src: - **Where people live.** Some buyers move to lower-cost regions or accept longer commutes. Others stay with parents or share housing longer than they would like.
segments.tr: - **居住地。** 一部の購入者は、より低コストな地域へ引っ越したり、より長い通勤時間を受け入れたりします。また、親と同居したり、望むよりも長くシェアハウスで暮らしたりする人もいます。

segments.src: - **Career flexibility.** Renters can move easily, but they also face rent increases and less control over where they live. Buyers who stretch to purchase may feel less able to change jobs or cities.
segments.tr: - **キャリアの柔軟性。** 賃貸居住者は容易に引っ越すことができますが、家賃の値上げに直面し、住む場所に対するコントロールも制限されます。無理をして購入した人は、転職や転居がしにくくなる可能性があります。

segments.src: None of this is a rule for every household, and many people are happy renting.
segments.tr: これらはすべての世帯に当てはまるルールではなく、賃貸生活を楽しんでいる人も多くいます。

segments.src: But for those who want to buy, the delay carries real costs.
segments.tr: しかし、購入を望む人にとって、その遅れは現実的なコストを伴います。

segments.src: ## The Wealth-Building Gap
segments.tr: ## 資産形成のギャップ

segments.src: Housing is the largest asset for many American families.
segments.tr: 住宅は、多くのアメリカ人家族にとって最大の資産です。

segments.src: Homeowners build equity as they pay down a mortgage and, in most periods, as home values rise.
segments.tr: 住宅所有者は、住宅ローンを返済する過程で、またほとんどの時期において住宅価値が上昇することで、資産（エクイティ）を築きます。

segments.src: Buying at 38 instead of 28 means ten fewer years of that process.
segments.tr: 28歳ではなく38歳で購入するということは、そのプロセスを10年分失うことを意味します。

segments.src: Federal Reserve data consistently show that homeowners have a much higher median net worth than renters.
segments.tr: 連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）のデータは、住宅所有者が賃貸居住者よりもはるかに高い純資産の中央値を持っていることを一貫して示しています。

segments.src: Part of that gap reflects age and income, since homeowners tend to be older and earn more.
segments.tr: そのギャップの一部は年齢と所得を反映しています。なぜなら、住宅所有者は高齢である傾向があり、所得も高いためです。

segments.src: Still, a later start leaves less time to build equity before retirement, and it can mean carrying a mortgage into later years.
segments.tr: それでも、スタートが遅れると退職までに資産を築く時間が減り、高齢になっても住宅ローンを抱え続けることになる可能性があります。

segments.src: There is also a generational question.
segments.tr: 世代間の問題もあります。

segments.src: Older cohorts often bought when homes were cheaper compared with incomes.
segments.tr: 上の世代は、所得と比較して住宅が安かった時期に購入することができました。

segments.src: Younger adults who start later may find it harder to match their parents' wealth, and may have less to pass on or less ability to help their own children.
segments.tr: スタートが遅い若い世代は、親の資産水準に追いつくのが難しく、子供に残せるものや、自分の子供を援助する能力が低くなる可能性があります。

segments.src: ## The Wider Housing Market
segments.tr: ## より広い住宅市場への影響

segments.src: An older first-time buyer affects more than one household.
segments.tr: 初めての住宅購入者の高齢化は、一つの世帯以上の影響を及ぼします。

segments.src: - **Slower move-up chain.** Starter homes are the first link. When fewer first-time buyers enter, owners of those homes have fewer buyers, which can slow the sequence of sales that frees up larger homes.
segments.tr: - **住み替えサイクルの鈍化。** スターターホーム（初めての住宅）は最初のリンクです。初めての住宅購入者が減ると、それらの住宅の所有者は買い手を見つけにくくなり、より大きな住宅への住み替えを促す売却の連鎖が遅くなる可能性があります。

segments.src: - **Rental demand.** Households that stay renters longer compete for apartments and single-family rentals, which can keep rents elevated.
segments.tr: - **賃貸需要。** 賃貸居住を長く続ける世帯は、アパートや一戸建ての賃貸物件を奪い合うことになり、家賃が高止まりする可能性があります。

segments.src: - **Local economies.** Home purchases support spending on furniture, repairs and services. Fewer and later purchases can soften those effects.
segments.tr: - **地域経済。** 住宅購入は、家具、修理、サービスへの支出を支えます。購入が減り、遅くなることは、それらの経済効果を弱める可能性があります。

segments.src: ## What Could Help
segments.tr: ## 何が助けになるのか

segments.src: No single fix exists, and economists disagree about the best mix.
segments.tr: 唯一の解決策は存在せず、経済学者の間でも最善の組み合わせについては意見が分かれています。

segments.src: Commonly discussed approaches include:
segments.tr: 一般的に議論されているアプローチには以下が含まれます。

segments.src: - **Building more homes**, particularly smaller and lower-priced ones, by easing zoning and permitting limits.
segments.tr: - **住宅の供給拡大。** 特にゾーニングや許認可の制限を緩和することで、より小さく低価格な住宅を増やすこと。

segments.src: - **Down payment assistance** programs offered by states and localities, which can help qualified buyers close the savings gap. These can also add demand, so their effect on prices is debated.
segments.tr: - **頭金支援プログラム。** 州や自治体が提供するプログラムで、資格のある購入者が貯蓄のギャップを埋めるのを助けることができます。これらは需要を押し上げる可能性もあるため、価格への影響については議論があります。

segments.src: - **Falling mortgage rates**, which would improve affordability but could also bring more buyers and more competition.
segments.tr: - **住宅ローン金利の低下。** これにより住宅購入能力は向上しますが、より多くの買い手が市場に参入し、競争が激化する可能性もあります。

segments.src: - **Easing the lock-in effect**, through ideas such as portable or assumable mortgages, though each has trade-offs.
segments.tr: - **ロックイン効果の緩和。** 住宅ローンのポータビリティ（持ち運び）や継承可能なローンといったアイデアを通じて行われますが、それぞれにトレードオフがあります。

segments.src: ## What Prospective Buyers Can Do
segments.tr: ## 購入検討者ができること

segments.src: Individual choices cannot solve a market-wide problem, but some steps may help:
segments.tr: 個人の選択で市場全体の問題を解決することはできませんが、いくつかのステップが役立つかもしれません。

segments.src: 1. Check your credit report and work on your score before applying.
segments.tr: 1. 申請前に信用レポートを確認し、スコアを改善する。

segments.src: 2. Set a realistic monthly budget that includes taxes, insurance and maintenance, not only the mortgage payment.
segments.tr: 2. 住宅ローンだけでなく、税金、保険、メンテナンス費用を含めた現実的な月間予算を設定する。

segments.src: 3. Look into state and local assistance programs and first-time buyer loan options.
segments.tr: 3. 州や自治体の支援プログラムや、初めての住宅購入者向けローンオプションを調べる。

segments.src: 4. Compare lenders, since offers can differ meaningfully.
segments.tr: 4. 貸し手（金融機関）を比較する。提示条件は大きく異なる可能性があるため。

segments.src: 5. Consider a wider search area or a smaller property as a first step.
segments.tr: 5. 最初のステップとして、より広い検索エリアや、より小さな物件を検討する。

segments.src: 6. Keep an emergency fund so that buying does not leave you without a cushion.
segments.tr: 6. 購入によって余裕がなくなることがないよう、緊急用資金を確保しておく。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.src: The rising age of the typical first-time buyer reflects a housing market where prices, borrowing costs and limited supply all push in the same direction.
segments.tr: 初めての住宅購入者の年齢上昇は、価格、借入コスト、供給制限のすべてが同じ方向に作用している住宅市場を反映しています。

segments.src: The delay shapes when families form, how quickly households build wealth and how the market functions.
segments.tr: この遅れは、家族形成の時期、世帯が資産を築くスピード、そして市場の機能の仕方に影響を与えています。

segments.src: Easing it will likely take a mix of more construction, better access to credit and time.
segments.tr: これを緩和するには、建設の増加、クレジットへのアクセスの改善、そして時間という組み合わせが必要になるでしょう。

de.title: Die ausgeschlossene Generation: Warum Erstkäufer von Immobilien immer älter werden

segments.src: For decades, buying a first home was a milestone people expected to reach in their twenties or early thirties.
segments.tr: Jahrzehntelang war der Kauf eines ersten Eigenheims ein Meilenstein, den die Menschen in ihren Zwanzigern oder frühen Dreißigern zu erreichen erwarteten.

segments.src: That expectation has shifted.
segments.tr: Diese Erwartung hat sich verschoben.

segments.src: According to recent annual surveys from the National Association of Realtors, the median age of first-time buyers has climbed to roughly 38, up from about 29 in the early 1980s.
segments.tr: Aktuellen Jahresumfragen der National Association of Realtors zufolge ist das Medianalter von Erstkäufern auf etwa 38 Jahre gestiegen, gegenüber rund 29 Jahren in den frühen 1980er Jahren.

segments.src: The share of first-time buyers among all purchasers has also hovered near record lows.
segments.tr: Der Anteil der Erstkäufer an allen Käufern bewegte sich ebenfalls nahe historischen Tiefstständen.

segments.src: Exact figures vary by year and survey, but the direction is clear: the entry point to homeownership keeps moving later in life.
segments.tr: Genaue Zahlen variieren je nach Jahr und Umfrage, aber die Richtung ist klar: Der Einstieg in Wohneigentum verschiebt sich immer weiter nach hinten im Leben.

segments.src: ## Why the Door Is Harder to Open
segments.tr: ## Warum sich die Tür schwerer öffnen lässt

segments.src: Three forces work together to delay purchases.
segments.tr: Drei Kräfte wirken zusammen, um Käufe hinauszuzögern.

segments.src: ### 1. High prices
segments.tr: ### 1. Hohe Preise

segments.src: Home prices rose sharply during the pandemic years and have mostly held their gains since.
segments.tr: Die Hauspreise sind während der Pandemiejahre stark gestiegen und haben ihre Gewinne seitdem größtenteils gehalten.

segments.src: Incomes have grown too, but not as fast as prices in many metro areas.
segments.tr: Die Einkommen sind zwar auch gewachsen, aber in vielen Ballungsräumen nicht so schnell wie die Preise.

segments.src: The result is a wider gap between what a typical household earns and what a typical home costs.
segments.tr: Das Ergebnis ist eine größere Kluft zwischen dem, was ein typischer Haushalt verdient, und dem, was ein typisches Haus kostet.

segments.src: A larger down payment, even a modest one of 5% to 10%, now takes years of saving, especially for renters who also face rising living costs.
segments.tr: Eine größere Anzahlung, selbst eine bescheidene von 5% bis 10%, erfordert heute jahrelanges Sparen, insbesondere für Mieter, die zudem mit steigenden Lebenshaltungskosten konfrontiert sind.

segments.src: ### 2. Elevated mortgage rates
segments.tr: ### 2. Erhöhte Hypothekenzinsen

segments.src: Mortgage rates were below 3% for a stretch in 2020 and 2021.
segments.tr: Die Hypothekenzinsen lagen in den Jahren 2020 und 2021 zeitweise unter 3%.

segments.src: Since then they have been far higher.
segments.tr: Seitdem sind sie deutlich höher.

segments.src: A higher rate raises the monthly payment on the same loan, which cuts the price a buyer can afford.
segments.tr: Ein höherer Zinssatz erhöht die monatliche Rate für dasselbe Darlehen, was den Preis senkt, den sich ein Käufer leisten kann.

segments.src: Even a gap of one or two percentage points can add hundreds of dollars to a monthly payment and shrink a buyer's budget by tens of thousands of dollars.
segments.tr: Bereits eine Differenz von ein oder zwei Prozentpunkten kann eine monatliche Rate um Hunderte von Dollar erhöhen und das Budget eines Käufers um Zehntausende von Dollar schrumpfen lassen.

segments.src: ### 3. Thin inventory
segments.tr: ### 3. Geringes Angebot

segments.src: Many current homeowners hold low-rate mortgages from earlier years.
segments.tr: Viele derzeitige Hausbesitzer haben zinsgünstige Hypotheken aus früheren Jahren.

segments.src: Selling would mean trading that loan for a much more expensive one, so many choose to stay put.
segments.tr: Ein Verkauf würde bedeuten, dieses Darlehen gegen ein viel teureres einzutauschen, weshalb viele vor Ort bleiben.

segments.src: This "lock-in effect" keeps fewer existing homes on the market.
segments.tr: Dieser "Lock-in-Effekt" sorgt dafür, dass weniger bestehende Häuser auf dem Markt sind.

segments.src: At the same time, years of underbuilding, along with zoning limits and higher construction costs, have left a shortfall in entry-level housing.
segments.tr: Gleichzeitig haben jahrelanger Unterbau, verbunden mit Bebauungsbeschränkungen und höheren Baukosten, zu einem Mangel an bezahlbarem Wohnraum für Einsteiger geführt.

segments.src: With fewer choices, buyers compete for the same modest homes, which supports prices.
segments.tr: Bei geringerem Angebot konkurrieren Käufer um dieselben bescheidenen Häuser, was die Preise stützt.

segments.src: ## What Delay Means for Families
segments.tr: ## Was die Verzögerung für Familien bedeutet

segments.src: The timing of homeownership is tied closely to other life decisions.
segments.tr: Der Zeitpunkt des Immobilienerwerbs ist eng mit anderen Lebensentscheidungen verknüpft.

segments.src: - **Family plans.** Surveys regularly find that housing costs are one reason some adults postpone having children or have fewer than they wanted. A stable home, space for a growing family and a good school district often figure into these choices.
segments.tr: - **Familienpläne.** Umfragen ergeben regelmäßig, dass die Wohnkosten ein Grund dafür sind, dass einige Erwachsene Kinder aufschieben oder weniger haben, als sie wollten. Ein stabiles Zuhause, Platz für eine wachsende Familie und ein guter Schulbezirk spielen bei diesen Entscheidungen oft eine Rolle.

segments.src: - **Where people live.** Some buyers move to lower-cost regions or accept longer commutes. Others stay with parents or share housing longer than they would like.
segments.tr: - **Wohnort.** Einige Käufer ziehen in günstigere Regionen oder nehmen längere Pendelzeiten in Kauf. Andere bleiben bei ihren Eltern oder teilen sich länger als gewünscht eine Unterkunft.

segments.src: - **Career flexibility.** Renters can move easily, but they also face rent increases and less control over where they live. Buyers who stretch to purchase may feel less able to change jobs or cities.
segments.tr: - **Karriereflexibilität.** Mieter können leicht umziehen, aber sie sind auch mit Mieterhöhungen und weniger Kontrolle über ihren Wohnort konfrontiert. Käufer, die sich finanziell strecken müssen, um zu kaufen, fühlen sich möglicherweise weniger in der Lage, den Job oder die Stadt zu wechseln.

segments.src: None of this is a rule for every household, and many people are happy renting.
segments.tr: Nichts davon ist eine Regel für jeden Haushalt, und viele Menschen mieten gerne.

segments.src: But for those who want to buy, the delay carries real costs.
segments.tr: Aber für diejenigen, die kaufen möchten, bringt die Verzögerung reale Kosten mit sich.

segments.src: ## The Wealth-Building Gap
segments.tr: ## Die Lücke beim Vermögensaufbau

segments.src: Housing is the largest asset for many American families.
segments.tr: Wohneigentum ist für viele amerikanische Familien das größte Vermögenswert.

segments.src: Homeowners build equity as they pay down a mortgage and, in most periods, as home values rise.
segments.tr: Hausbesitzer bauen Eigenkapital auf, während sie eine Hypothek abbezahlen und, in den meisten Phasen, während die Immobilienwerte steigen.

segments.src: Buying at 38 instead of 28 means ten fewer years of that process.
segments.tr: Mit 38 statt mit 28 zu kaufen bedeutet zehn Jahre weniger von diesem Prozess.

segments.src: Federal Reserve data consistently show that homeowners have a much higher median net worth than renters.
segments.tr: Daten der Federal Reserve zeigen durchgehend, dass Hausbesitzer ein wesentlich höheres Medianvermögen als Mieter haben.

segments.src: Part of that gap reflects age and income, since homeowners tend to be older and earn more.
segments.tr: Ein Teil dieser Lücke spiegelt Alter und Einkommen wider, da Hausbesitzer tendenziell älter sind und mehr verdienen.

segments.src: Still, a later start leaves less time to build equity before retirement, and it can mean carrying a mortgage into later years.
segments.tr: Dennoch lässt ein späterer Start weniger Zeit für den Eigenkapitalaufbau vor dem Ruhestand, und es kann bedeuten, dass man eine Hypothek bis ins hohe Alter mit sich trägt.

segments.src: There is also a generational question.
segments.tr: Es gibt auch eine Generationsfrage.

segments.src: Older cohorts often bought when homes were cheaper compared with incomes.
segments.tr: Ältere Kohorten haben oft gekauft, als Häuser im Vergleich zu den Einkommen billiger waren.

segments.src: Younger adults who start later may find it harder to match their parents' wealth, and may have less to pass on or less ability to help their own children.
segments.tr: Jüngere Erwachsene, die später anfangen, finden es möglicherweise schwieriger, den Wohlstand ihrer Eltern zu erreichen, und haben möglicherweise weniger zu vererben oder weniger Möglichkeiten, ihren eigenen Kindern zu helfen.

segments.src: ## The Wider Housing Market
segments.tr: ## Der breitere Wohnungsmarkt

segments.src: An older first-time buyer affects more than one household.
segments.tr: Ein älterer Erstkäufer betrifft mehr als nur einen Haushalt.

segments.src: - **Slower move-up chain.** Starter homes are the first link. When fewer first-time buyers enter, owners of those homes have fewer buyers, which can slow the sequence of sales that frees up larger homes.
segments.tr: - **Langsamere Umzugskette.** Startwohnungen sind das erste Glied. Wenn weniger Erstkäufer auf den Markt kommen, haben die Eigentümer dieser Häuser weniger Käufer, was die Verkaufskette verlangsamen kann, die größere Häuser freisetzt.

segments.src: - **Rental demand.** Households that stay renters longer compete for apartments and single-family rentals, which can keep rents elevated.
segments.tr: - **Mietnachfrage.** Haushalte, die länger Mieter bleiben, konkurrieren um Wohnungen und Einfamilienhäuser zur Miete, was die Mieten hoch halten kann.

segments.src: - **Local economies.** Home purchases support spending on furniture, repairs and services. Fewer and later purchases can soften those effects.
segments.tr: - **Lokale Wirtschaft.** Immobilienkäufe stützen die Ausgaben für Möbel, Reparaturen und Dienstleistungen. Weniger und spätere Käufe können diese Effekte abmildern.

segments.src: ## What Could Help
segments.tr: ## Was helfen könnte

segments.src: No single fix exists, and economists disagree about the best mix.
segments.tr: Es gibt keine einzelne Lösung, und Ökonomen sind sich über die beste Mischung uneinig.

segments.src: Commonly discussed approaches include:
segments.tr: Häufig diskutierte Ansätze umfassen:

segments.src: - **Building more homes**, particularly smaller and lower-priced ones, by easing zoning and permitting limits.
segments.tr: - **Bau weiterer Häuser**, insbesondere kleinerer und günstigerer, durch Lockerung von Bebauungs- und Genehmigungsbeschränkungen.

segments.src: - **Down payment assistance** programs offered by states and localities, which can help qualified buyers close the savings gap. These can also add demand, so their effect on prices is debated.
segments.tr: - **Programme zur Unterstützung der Anzahlung**, die von Bundesstaaten und Kommunen angeboten werden und qualifizierten Käufern helfen können, die Sparlücke zu schließen. Diese können auch die Nachfrage ankurbeln, weshalb ihre Auswirkungen auf die Preise umstritten sind.

segments.src: - **Falling mortgage rates**, which would improve affordability but could also bring more buyers and more competition.
segments.tr: - **Fallende Hypothekenzinsen**, die die Erschwinglichkeit verbessern würden, aber auch mehr Käufer und mehr Wettbewerb bringen könnten.

segments.src: - **Easing the lock-in effect**, through ideas such as portable or assumable mortgages, though each has trade-offs.
segments.tr: - **Lockerung des Lock-in-Effekts** durch Ideen wie übertragbare oder übernehmbare Hypotheken, obwohl jede ihre Kompromisse hat.

segments.src: ## What Prospective Buyers Can Do
segments.tr: ## Was prospective Käufer tun können

segments.src: Individual choices cannot solve a market-wide problem, but some steps may help:
segments.tr: Individuelle Entscheidungen können ein marktweites Problem nicht lösen, aber einige Schritte können helfen:

segments.src: 1. Check your credit report and work on your score before applying.
segments.tr: 1. Überprüfen Sie Ihren Kreditbericht und arbeiten Sie an Ihrem Score, bevor Sie sich bewerben.

segments.src: 2. Set a realistic monthly budget that includes taxes, insurance and maintenance, not only the mortgage payment.
segments.tr: 2. Legen Sie ein realistisches Monatsbudget fest, das Steuern, Versicherungen und Instandhaltung umfasst, nicht nur die Hypothekenzahlung.

segments.src: 3. Look into state and local assistance programs and first-time buyer loan options.
segments.tr: 3. Informieren Sie sich über staatliche und lokale Unterstützungsprogramme sowie über Kreditoptionen für Erstkäufer.

segments.src: 4. Compare lenders, since offers can differ meaningfully.
segments.tr: 4. Vergleichen Sie Kreditgeber, da Angebote erheblich voneinander abweichen können.

segments.src: 5. Consider a wider search area or a smaller property as a first step.
segments.tr: 5. Erwägen Sie als ersten Schritt ein größeres Suchgebiet oder eine kleinere Immobilie.

segments.src: 6. Keep an emergency fund so that buying does not leave you without a cushion.
segments.tr: 6. Behalten Sie einen Notgroschen, damit der Kauf Sie nicht ohne Polster dastehen lässt.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Das Fazit

segments.src: The rising age of the typical first-time buyer reflects a housing market where prices, borrowing costs and limited supply all push in the same direction.
segments.tr: Das steigende Alter des typischen Erstkäufers spiegelt einen Wohnungsmarkt wider, in dem Preise, Kreditkosten und begrenztes Angebot alle in dieselbe Richtung drängen.

segments.src: Easing it will likely take a mix of more construction, better access to credit and time.
segments.tr: Sie zu mildern wird wahrscheinlich eine Mischung aus mehr Bauaktivität, besserem Kreditzugang und Zeit erfordern.

vi.title: Thế hệ bị bỏ lại: Tại sao người mua nhà lần đầu ngày càng lớn tuổi hơn

segments.src: For decades, buying a first home was a milestone people expected to reach in their twenties or early thirties.
segments.tr: Trong nhiều thập kỷ, việc mua ngôi nhà đầu tiên là một cột mốc mà mọi người kỳ vọng sẽ đạt được ở độ tuổi 20 hoặc đầu 30.

segments.src: That expectation has shifted.
segments.tr: Kỳ vọng đó đã thay đổi.

segments.src: According to recent annual surveys from the National Association of Realtors, the median age of first-time buyers has climbed to roughly 38, up from about 29 in the early 1980s.
segments.tr: Theo các cuộc khảo sát hàng năm gần đây từ Hiệp hội Môi giới Bất động sản Quốc gia, độ tuổi trung vị của những người mua nhà lần đầu đã tăng lên khoảng 38, tăng so với mức khoảng 29 vào đầu những năm 1980.

segments.src: The share of first-time buyers among all purchasers has also hovered near record lows.
segments.tr: Tỷ lệ người mua nhà lần đầu trong tổng số người mua cũng dao động gần mức thấp kỷ lục.

segments.src: Exact figures vary by year and survey, but the direction is clear: the entry point to homeownership keeps moving later in life.
segments.tr: Các con số chính xác thay đổi theo năm và cuộc khảo sát, nhưng xu hướng là rõ ràng: thời điểm gia nhập thị trường sở hữu nhà ngày càng lùi về giai đoạn sau của cuộc đời.

segments.src: ## Why the Door Is Harder to Open
segments.tr: ## Tại sao cánh cửa lại khó mở hơn

segments.src: Three forces work together to delay purchases.
segments.tr: Ba lực lượng tác động đồng thời làm chậm lại các giao dịch mua nhà.

segments.src: ### 1. High prices
segments.tr: ### 1. Giá nhà cao

segments.src: Home prices rose sharply during the pandemic years and have mostly held their gains since.
segments.tr: Giá nhà đã tăng mạnh trong những năm đại dịch và phần lớn vẫn giữ vững mức tăng đó kể từ đó.

segments.src: Incomes have grown too, but not as fast as prices in many metro areas.
segments.tr: Thu nhập cũng đã tăng lên, nhưng không nhanh bằng giá nhà ở nhiều khu vực đô thị.

segments.src: The result is a wider gap between what a typical household earns and what a typical home costs.
segments.tr: Kết quả là khoảng cách ngày càng nới rộng giữa thu nhập của một hộ gia đình điển hình và chi phí của một ngôi khoản nhà ở điển hình.

segments.src: A larger down payment, even a modest one of 5% to 10%, now takes years of saving, especially for renters who also face rising living costs.
segments.tr: Một khoản trả trước lớn hơn, ngay cả khoản thanh toán khiêm tốn từ 5% đến 10%, nay đòi hỏi nhiều năm tiết kiệm, đặc biệt đối với những người đi thuê nhà, những người cũng phải đối mặt với chi phí sinh hoạt ngày càng tăng.

segments.src: ### 2. Elevated mortgage rates
segments.tr: ### 2. Lãi suất thế chấp ở mức cao

segments.src: Mortgage rates were below 3% for a stretch in 2020 and 2021.
segments.tr: Lãi suất thế chấp đã duy trì dưới 3% trong một khoảng thời gian vào năm 2020 và 2021.

segments.src: Since then they have been far higher.
segments.tr: Kể từ đó, lãi suất đã cao hơn rất nhiều.

segments.src: A higher rate raises the monthly payment on the same loan, which cuts the price a buyer can afford.
segments.tr: Lãi suất cao hơn làm tăng khoản thanh toán hàng tháng cho cùng một khoản vay, từ đó làm giảm mức giá mà người mua có thể chi trả.

segments.src: Even a gap of one or two percentage points can add hundreds of dollars to a monthly payment and shrink a buyer's budget by tens of thousands of dollars.
segments.tr: Ngay cả khoảng cách một hoặc hai điểm phần trăm cũng có thể cộng thêm hàng trăm đô la vào khoản thanh toán hàng tháng và làm thu hẹp ngân sách của người mua hàng chục nghìn đô la.

segments.src: ### 3. Thin inventory
segments.tr: ### 3. Nguồn cung khan hiếm

segments.src: Many current homeowners hold low-rate mortgages from earlier years.
segments.tr: Nhiều chủ nhà hiện tại đang giữ các khoản vay thế chấp lãi suất thấp từ những năm trước.

segments.src: Selling would mean trading that loan for a much more expensive one, so many choose to stay put.
segments.tr: Việc bán nhà đồng nghĩa với việc đổi khoản vay đó lấy một khoản vay đắt đỏ hơn nhiều, vì vậy nhiều người chọn ở lại chỗ cũ.

segments.src: This "lock-in effect" keeps fewer existing homes on the market.
segments.tr: "Hiệu ứng khóa chặt" này khiến cho số lượng nhà hiện có trên thị trường ít đi.

segments.src: At the same time, years of underbuilding, along with zoning limits and higher construction costs, have left a shortfall in entry-level housing.
segments.tr: Cùng lúc đó, nhiều năm xây dựng thiếu hụt, cùng với các giới hạn về quy hoạch vùng và chi phí xây dựng cao hơn, đã để lại sự thiếu hụt trong phân khúc nhà ở phổ thông.

segments.src: With fewer choices, buyers compete for the same modest homes, which supports prices.
segments.tr: Với ít lựa chọn hơn, người mua cạnh tranh cho cùng một số lượng nhà ở khiêm tốn, qua đó giữ cho giá nhà không giảm.

segments.src: ## What Delay Means for Families
segments.tr: ## Sự chậm trễ có ý nghĩa gì đối với các gia đình

segments.src: The timing of homeownership is tied closely to other life decisions.
segments.tr: Thời điểm sở hữu nhà gắn liền chặt chẽ với các quyết định khác trong cuộc sống.

segments.src: - **Family plans.** Surveys regularly find that housing costs are one reason some adults postpone having children or have fewer than they wanted. A stable home, space for a growing family and a good school district often figure into these choices.
segments.tr: - **Kế hoạch gia đình.** Các cuộc khảo sát thường xuyên cho thấy chi phí nhà ở là một lý do khiến một số người trưởng thành hoãn việc có con hoặc sinh ít con hơn mong muốn. Một ngôi nhà ổn định, không gian cho một gia đình đang phát triển và một khu vực trường học tốt thường đóng vai trò quan trọng trong những lựa chọn này.

segments.src: - **Where people live.** Some buyers move to lower-cost regions or accept longer commutes. Others stay with parents or share housing longer than they would like.
segments.tr: - **Nơi sinh sống.** Một số người mua chuyển đến các khu vực có chi phí thấp hơn hoặc chấp nhận thời gian di chuyển dài hơn. Những người khác sống cùng bố mẹ hoặc chia sẻ nhà ở lâu hơn mong muốn của họ.

segments.src: - **Career flexibility.** Renters can move easily, but they also face rent increases and less control over where they live. Buyers who stretch to purchase may feel less able to change jobs or cities.
segments.tr: - **Sự linh hoạt trong sự nghiệp.** Người thuê nhà có thể di chuyển dễ dàng, nhưng họ cũng phải đối mặt với việc tăng giá thuê và ít quyền kiểm soát hơn đối với nơi mình sống. Những người mua nhà phải gắng sức để mua có thể cảm thấy ít khả năng thay đổi công việc hoặc thành phố hơn.

segments.src: None of this is a rule for every household, and many people are happy renting.
segments.tr: Không có điều nào trong số này là quy tắc áp dụng cho mọi hộ gia đình, và nhiều người cảm thấy hạnh phúc với việc đi thuê nhà.

segments.src: But for those who want to buy, the delay carries real costs.
segments.tr: Nhưng đối với những người muốn mua nhà, sự chậm trễ này mang lại những chi phí thực tế.

segments.src: ## The Wealth-Building Gap
segments.tr: ## Khoảng cách tạo dựng tài sản

segments.src: Housing is the largest asset for many American families.
segments.tr: Nhà ở là tài sản lớn nhất đối với nhiều gia đình Mỹ.

segments.src: Homeowners build equity as they pay down a mortgage and, in most periods, as home values rise.
segments.tr: Chủ nhà tích lũy vốn chủ sở hữu khi họ trả dần khoản vay thế chấp và, trong hầu hết các giai đoạn, khi giá trị nhà tăng lên.

segments.src: Buying at 38 instead of 28 means ten fewer years of that process.
segments.tr: Mua nhà ở tuổi 38 thay vì 28 đồng nghĩa với việc mất đi mười năm thực hiện quá trình đó.

segments.src: Federal Reserve data consistently show that homeowners have a much higher median net worth than renters.
segments.tr: Dữ liệu của Cục Dự trữ Liên bang liên tục cho thấy chủ nhà có giá trị tài sản ròng trung vị cao hơn nhiều so với người thuê nhà.

segments.src: Part of that gap reflects age and income, since homeowners tend to be older and earn more.
segments.tr: Một phần của khoảng cách đó phản ánh độ tuổi và thu nhập, vì chủ nhà thường lớn tuổi hơn và kiếm được nhiều tiền hơn.

segments.src: Still, a later start leaves less time to build equity before retirement, and it can mean carrying a mortgage into later years.
segments.tr: Dẫu vậy, việc bắt đầu muộn hơn sẽ có ít thời gian hơn để tích lũy vốn chủ sở hữu trước khi nghỉ hưu, và điều đó có thể đồng nghĩa với việc phải gánh khoản vay thế chấp sang những năm sau này.

segments.src: There is also a generational question.
segments.tr: Cũng có một vấn đề về thế hệ.

segments.src: Older cohorts often bought when homes were cheaper compared with incomes.
segments.tr: Các thế hệ đi trước thường mua nhà khi nhà rẻ hơn so với thu nhập.

segments.src: Younger adults who start later may find it harder to match their parents' wealth, and may have less to pass on or less ability to help their own children.
segments.tr: Những người trẻ tuổi bắt đầu muộn hơn có thể thấy khó khăn hơn trong việc đạt được mức tài sản như cha mẹ họ, và có thể có ít tài sản hơn để để lại hoặc ít khả năng giúp đỡ con cái của chính họ hơn.

segments.src: ## The Wider Housing Market
segments.tr: ## Thị trường nhà ở rộng lớn hơn

segments.src: An older first-time buyer affects more than one household.
segments.tr: Một người mua nhà lần đầu lớn tuổi hơn không chỉ tác động đến một hộ gia đình.

segments.src: - **Slower move-up chain.** Starter homes are the first link. When fewer first-time buyers enter, owners of those homes have fewer buyers, which can slow the sequence of sales that frees up larger homes.
segments.tr: - **Chuỗi chuyển nhà chậm hơn.** Nhà khởi nghiệp là mắt xích đầu tiên. Khi có ít người mua nhà lần đầu tham gia, chủ sở hữu của những ngôi nhà đó sẽ có ít người mua hơn, điều này có thể làm chậm chuỗi giao dịch bán nhà vốn giúp giải phóng các ngôi nhà lớn hơn.

segments.src: - **Rental demand.** Households that stay renters longer compete for apartments and single-family rentals, which can keep rents elevated.
segments.tr: - **Nhu cầu thuê nhà.** Các hộ gia đình tiếp tục thuê nhà lâu hơn sẽ cạnh tranh cho các căn hộ và nhà ở cho thuê đơn lập, điều này có thể giữ giá thuê ở mức cao.

segments.src: - **Local economies.** Home purchases support spending on furniture, repairs and services. Fewer and later purchases can soften those effects.
segments.tr: - **Kinh tế địa phương.** Việc mua nhà hỗ trợ chi tiêu cho đồ nội thất, sửa chữa và các dịch vụ. Các giao dịch mua ít hơn và muộn hơn có thể làm giảm bớt những tác động tích cực đó.

segments.src: ## What Could Help
segments.tr: ## Điều gì có thể giúp ích

segments.src: No single fix exists, and economists disagree about the best mix.
segments.tr: Không có giải pháp đơn lẻ nào tồn tại, và các nhà kinh tế không đồng tình về sự kết hợp tốt nhất.

segments.src: Commonly discussed approaches include:
segments.tr: Các cách tiếp cận thường được thảo luận bao gồm:

segments.src: - **Building more homes**, particularly smaller and lower-priced ones, by easing zoning and permitting limits.
segments.tr: - **Xây dựng thêm nhiều nhà ở**, đặc biệt là nhà nhỏ và giá rẻ hơn, bằng cách nới lỏng các giới hạn về quy hoạch vùng và cấp phép.

segments.src: - **Down payment assistance** programs offered by states and localities, which can help qualified buyers close the savings gap. These can also add demand, so their effect on prices is debated.
segments.tr: - **Các chương trình hỗ trợ trả trước** do các tiểu bang và địa phương cung cấp, có thể giúp những người mua đủ điều kiện thu hẹp khoảng cách tiết kiệm. Các chương trình này cũng có thể làm tăng nhu cầu, vì vậy tác động của chúng đối với giá cả vẫn là vấn đề gây tranh cãi.

segments.src: - **Falling mortgage rates**, which would improve affordability but could also bring more buyers and more competition.
segments.tr: - **Lãi suất thế chấp giảm**, điều này sẽ cải thiện khả năng chi trả nhưng cũng có thể mang lại nhiều người mua hơn và nhiều sự cạnh tranh hơn.

segments.src: - **Easing the lock-in effect**, through ideas such as portable or assumable mortgages, though each has trade-offs.
segments.tr: - **Làm giảm hiệu ứng khóa chặt**, thông qua các ý tưởng như thế chấp có thể chuyển nhượng hoặc có thể nhận chuyển giao, mặc dù mỗi giải pháp đều có những đánh đổi riêng.

segments.src: ## What Prospective Buyers Can Do
segments.tr: ## Người mua tiềm năng có thể làm gì

segments.src: Individual choices cannot solve a market-wide problem, but some steps may help:
segments.tr: Các lựa chọn cá nhân không thể giải quyết một vấn đề mang tính toàn thị trường, nhưng một số bước có thể giúp ích:

segments.src: 1. Check your credit report and work on your score before applying.
segments.tr: 1. Kiểm tra báo cáo tín dụng của bạn và cải thiện điểm số trước khi nộp đơn.

segments.src: 2. Set a realistic monthly budget that includes taxes, insurance and maintenance, not only the mortgage payment.
segments.tr: 2. Lập ngân sách hàng tháng thực tế bao gồm thuế, bảo hiểm và chi phí bảo trì, chứ không chỉ riêng khoản thanh toán thế chấp.

segments.src: 3. Look into state and local assistance programs and first-time buyer loan options.
segments.tr: 3. Tìm hiểu các chương trình hỗ trợ của tiểu bang và địa phương cùng các tùy chọn cho vay mua nhà lần đầu.

segments.src: 4. Compare lenders, since offers can differ meaningfully.
segments.tr: 4. So sánh các bên cho vay, vì các ưu đãi có thể khác biệt đáng kể.

segments.src: 5. Consider a wider search area or a smaller property as a first step.
segments.tr: 5. Cân nhắc tìm kiếm ở một khu vực rộng hơn hoặc một bất động sản nhỏ hơn như một bước khởi đầu.

segments.src: 6. Keep an emergency fund so that buying does not leave you without a cushion.
segments.tr: 6. Duy trì quỹ khẩn cấp để việc mua nhà không khiến bạn rơi vào tình trạng không có khoản dự phòng nào.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Điểm mấu chốt

segments.src: The rising age of the typical first-time buyer reflects a housing market where prices, borrowing costs and limited supply all push in the same direction.
segments.tr: Độ tuổi ngày càng tăng của người mua nhà lần đầu điển hình phản ánh một thị trường nhà ở nơi giá cả, chi phí vay mượn và nguồn cung hạn chế đều đẩy theo cùng một hướng.

segments.src: The delay shapes when families form, how quickly households build wealth and how the market functions.
segments.tr: Sự chậm trễ này định hình thời điểm các gia đình hình thành, tốc độ tích lũy tài sản của các hộ gia đình và cách thức hoạt động của thị trường.

segments.src: Easing it will likely take a mix of more construction, better access to credit and time.
segments.tr: Việc giảm bớt tình trạng này có lẽ sẽ cần sự kết hợp của việc xây dựng nhiều hơn, khả năng tiếp cận tín dụng tốt hơn và thời gian.
